name: Track hiring spikes from Personio, Workable, Recruitee and Teamtailor career sites

parameters.content:
### How it works
This workflow helps sales teams, recruiters and investors notice when a company starts hiring. Every Monday it fetches all open jobs from a watchlist of company career sites on Personio, Workable, Recruitee, SmartRecruiters and Teamtailor through an Apify actor. It keeps the roles you care about, compares job URLs with your Google Sheet and stores only new ones. You then get one report that ranks companies by new openings and highlights hiring spikes. The first run only saves a baseline, so you are not flooded with every open job. A failed Apify run sends an alert.

### Setup
You need an Apify account (the free plan works, the actor charges per job), Google Sheets and Gmail.
1. Create a Header Auth credential: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`.
2. Create a sheet with a tab named `Jobs` and these columns in row 1: url, company, title, department, location, remote, ats, published, first_seen.
3. Fill in the Configuration node: companies, sheet URL, tab name, your email.
4. Connect Google Sheets and Gmail, run once to save the baseline, then activate.

### Customization
Add career page URLs to `companies`, comma separated. Use titleKeywords such as sales,engineer to track only some roles. Change spikeThreshold to set how many new jobs count as a spike. Reposted jobs with a new URL count as new.

## Collect open jobs
Loads your watchlist and fetches every open job from the company career sites through one Apify run.

## Spot what changed
Keeps the roles you care about and compares job URLs with the sheet, so only new openings continue.

## Log and report
Stores new jobs, then ranks companies by new openings. The first run only saves a baseline.

## Failed Apify run
Sends an alert so a failed week is not mistaken for a week without new jobs.
